policy: Scene-scoped physical state is evidence-backed. A scene observation is not silently carried forward as a permanent state. Unknown, unmentioned and unchanged are distinct. Dialogue and stage directions remain verbatim in imported scene records.

value_rules: Use unknown when source does not establish a value.
Use observed_only for a transient action or position that must not be assumed to persist.
Use unresolved when source scenes conflict.
Do not infer a location from a character being a participant in a scene.
Do not infer continuity between scenes without explicit evidence.
Character knowledge belongs in knowledge-ledger.json; prop state belongs in prop-ledger.json.
